source_read: https://tkmenus.com/fullers/<menu code> for 10 pubs (codes read from each pub website's own /food/menus page: turkshead12, londonspride12, barrowboyandbanker11, admiralty12, sanctuaryhouse13, parcelyard14, georgeiv13, frogandwicket12, headoftheriver14, herefordarms14), 54 tab pages saved 2026-10-10; no date shown on the pages; robots.txt of tkmenus.com disallows only /fonts/ /views/ /*.less$
not_verifiable: the pages show no date or version; fullers.co.uk answers 403 to this environment so the chain's own pub finder could not be used and the 10 pubs are the ones whose own websites could be found and read, not all of Fuller's pubs
notes: Re-read with a regex-only parser (no DOM reader, none of the repo's readers) over all 54 saved pages: for every one of the 160 published items every number (kcal, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, salt) matched the pop-up of at least two pubs (0 items without a matching print, 0 matched at fewer than 2 pubs), and the printed Contains / May contain lines of the matching prints mean the same allergens at every pub (13 items differ only by a redundant 'Nuts' label beside 'Tree Nuts (...)'). Four pages (admiralty12, parcelyard14, georgeiv13, sanctuaryhouse13) were downloaded again at about 23:50 UTC on 2026-10-10 with a different User-Agent and compared: 109 prints of published items, 0 differences. 17 published dishes at The Admiralty were also read in the live page rendered in headless Chromium (JavaScript on, the visible pop-up text of each dish; a different method from both the script and the regex reader): all seven numbers identical. Not published: 165 dishes printed at one pub only, 23 whose figures differ between pubs, 21 printed twice with different figures at one pub (or once as a dish and once as a choice), 126 tea/coffee rows (milk is a separate choice), 415 choices/extras listed under another dish, 35 rows printing '-'. Held back (impossible figures, or an allergen row that contradicts the dish name): Rigatoni mac & cheese (572,356 kcal and 22,021 g protein printed), Roasted bone marrow (690 kcal vs 263 from its own macros), Club sandwich, Miniature chocolate brownie and Fusilli pesto pasta (children's) (no gluten marked). marked_ok = the 10 medium audit flags judged as printed (identical at the pubs that print them): salt 6-11 g on garlic roasted chicken, Greek mezze, mixed olives and two sea bass dishes; the 'to share' short rib (2197 kcal, 124 g protein, 10.2 g salt); two add-on calorie gaps (22-23%); The Admiral's fish pie (mash-topped, no gluten marked). Seven dishes whose calories differ 15-23% from 4P+4C+9F carry that in their items.csv notes.
